newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 16.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - The head of state forest agency SODEFOR denies in an interview that the World Bank could suspend its funding. He says donors want a restructuring at the agency that will lead to 350 jobs being cut. - Governing board of Ivory Coast's biggest university, Abidjan's Cocody campus, has decided that the 1996/97 academic year will be extended from September 23, after the summer holiday, to November 30. It had been feared the whole year could be written off because of frequent disruptions to campus life from student protests. LA VOIE - Ivory Coast water company SODECI began a five-day seminar on the stock exchange for its shareholders. LE JOUR - Cauris Investissement, a risk capital firm funded by the West African Development Bank (BOAD) and donors, is lending 200 million CFA francs to the hotel sector in Mali and 125 million to the Bank of Africa, Burkina Faso. - An Air Afrique board meeting began on Tuesday. On the agenda, the budget for the coming financial year and progress on setting up a leasing company, part of the plan to solve a crippling debt problem. ($=605 CFA) -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
